Suzu signing off! Even the daisies look drowsy now, so goodnight!
Goodnight, Nekomura! My apron still smells like sunshine and soil!
Oh my whiskers, I'm the last one up again. Night, dearies!
Sleep tight, all! I'll be at the stall with armfuls of news and blooms!
The moon's up, the shop's shut, and I'm off to snooze. Goodnight!
Oh my whiskers, the honeysuckle smells proud tonight. Bed for me!
Sweet dreams, village! I'll tidy the ribbon spools in the morning!
Night, night! I always sleep best after a day elbow-deep in flowers!
Goodnight! The alley cat and I are calling it a night together!
Oh my whiskers, someone left a bucket out and I nearly tripped. Night!
Sleep well, neighbors! Tomorrow's bouquet order is already in my head!
Goodnight! My basket's empty, my heart's full, and my bed is near!
Oh my whiskers, that sunset looked like a peach rose opening. Night!
Sweet dreams! The ferns by the shrine are curling up to sleep too!
Night, night! Fresh stock arrives at dawn, so I really must rest!
Goodnight, lovely village! I'll leave the porch lantern on a bit!
Oh my whiskers, my feet are tired but my mouth never is. Night!
Sleep tight! The bellflowers are ringing no one to bed but me!
Goodnight! I heard three rumors today and I'll spill every one at market!
Oh my whiskers, the whole street is quiet. Time I matched it!
Night, night! Even my scissors are resting in their drawer!
Sweet dreams! I hope tomorrow's posies smell half this good!
Goodnight, dearies! I'll dream of seed packets, I just know it!
Oh my whiskers, my ribbon came loose again. Night, everyone!
Sleep well! The mint pot by the door is keeping the moths away!
Goodnight! If the moon were a flower, it'd be a big white peony!
Oh my whiskers, the crickets beat me to the lullabies tonight!
Night, night! I'll wave from the stall bright and early, promise!
Sweet dreams! Every petal out there is dreaming right along with you!
Goodnight, Nekomura! My pillow's fluffier than a dandelion puff!
Oh my whiskers, I left a vase half done. It will keep till morning!
Sleep tight! The willow's drooping over the pond like a tired friend!
Goodnight! Somebody's baking bread late and it smells like heaven!
Oh my whiskers, the stars are outnumbering the blossoms tonight!
Night, night! Even the watering can looks cozy in its corner!
Sweet dreams! The violets and I are both closing our eyes now!
Goodnight, dear neighbors! Mind the step by my shop on your way home!
Oh my whiskers, what a chatty evening! My throat needs a rest too!
Sleep well! I'll pick the freshest stems before the rooster even stirs!
Goodnight! The clouds are drifting off and so am I. Night, all!
Oh my whiskers, the lantern oil's nearly gone. That settles it!
Night, night! I'll leave the gossip for daylight, cross my heart!
Sweet dreams! The marigolds glow like little suns in the dark!
Goodnight! My cat's already claimed the warm spot on the quilt!
Oh my whiskers, the roofer waved at me and I talked his ear off. Night!
Sleep tight! Every bloom out there is a goodnight hug from me!
Goodnight! The gate squeaks softer when the whole village is asleep!
Oh my whiskers, my braid's half undone and so am I. Bedtime!
Night, night! The dahlias keep their colors even with the moon out!
Sweet dreams! I'll have the tulip buckets filled before you wake!
Goodnight, you wonderful lot! Watch the puddles near the well!
Oh my whiskers, I promised the baker a bouquet at sunrise. Night!
Sleep well! The night air smells like dew and something blooming!
Goodnight! Even the gossip can wait till the stall opens. Mostly!
Oh my whiskers, that owl hooted right at me. Goodnight, owl!
Night, night! The potted herbs are nodding on the windowsill!
Sweet dreams! I hope your dreams smell like fresh lavender!
Goodnight, Nekomura! I'll sweep the petals off the step tomorrow!
Oh my whiskers, the whole square went quiet in one breath. Night!
Sleep tight! My gloves are hung up and my boots are by the door!
